prompt: The Whisper lyrics transcription in moja-ml-service is producing garbled output for Turkish songs. I need to fix the transcriber to handle multiple languages better. It's currently auto-detecting but the Persian normalizer is mangling non-Persian text.

assertions.name: identifies root cause
assertions.description: Identifies that persian_normalizer is applied unconditionally regardless of detected language

assertions.name: suggests language gating
assertions.description: Suggests gating Persian normalization on detected_language or language parameter

assertions.name: references service.py
assertions.description: References service.py as a file that needs changes

assertions.name: references lrc_formatter.py
assertions.description: References lrc_formatter.py or the LRC formatting step

assertions.name: includes test cases
assertions.description: Includes test cases for non-Persian languages

assertions.name: detects dead config
assertions.description: Identifies that whisper_language_hint config is unused or should be cleaned up
